name: lightcraft-cli
notes: Companion command-line tool for the macOS install, pinned 2026-11-04 to the same v0.18.0 release as lightcraft.lock.json; the DMG does not carry it. Digest copied from the release's SHA256SUMS.txt, bytes from GitHub asset metadata, both matched against the downloaded zip. The zip carries LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE and NOTICE beside the binary. lightcraft-cli --version prints 'lightcraft-cli 0.18.0', which install.mjs requires before attaching. Exercised by scripts/extensions/prove-lightcraft-drive.ts: headless mcp --library, and mcp --connect to the live window.
